notes: Auto-stop recording at 0 speed (Settings > Recording): switch it on and pick the standstill seconds (5-600 s, default 30). It only arms after the car has actually moved and needs a live GPS fix, so starting the logger in the paddock survives the grid wait and a GPS dropout cannot end a session. Auto-upload on Wi-Fi (Settings > Cloud upload): pending sessions drain the moment Wi-Fi connects, or right away when switched on while already on Wi-Fi.
